sealed_A0.statement: For every cut A on the common vertex universe U and union-incidence graph I_sigma, max_i mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A) <= mim_{I_sigma}(A) <= 3*max_i mim_{I_{sigma,i}}(A). Therefore for every common branch decomposition T, COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T) <= mim_{I_sigma}(T) <= 3*COMMON_LAYER_MIM(T).
sealed_A0.consequence: The existence of a seed-bounded common layout for the three layers is equivalent up to factor 3 to the existence of a seed-bounded mim-width decomposition of the single union-incidence graph I_sigma on the same tree.

sealed_conditional_D1.hypothesis: A common decomposition has per-layer cut mim-width at most w.
sealed_conditional_D1.conclusion: The joint 1-neighborhood boundary alphabet for 3 layers x 4 actual colors has at most n^{O(12w)} signatures per coarse class.
sealed_conditional_D1.all_coarse_classes: Using the crude B0 bound B(s), the conservative combined count is n^{O(12*w*B(s))}.
sealed_conditional_D1.component_masks: The four-bit survivor-side forbidden-color mask of every external component is determined by the d=1 signature.

firewalls: No bounded width of I_sigma is proved.
No polynomial-time construction of a common decomposition is proved.
No D1 source-sufficiency theorem is proved.
No reconstruction theorem for the P7 survivor system is proved.
